race.description: Auswide Plumbing And Civil Mdn Plate
race.comment: Siding with CONQUER THE WORLD (9) who ran a strong race on debut here over 1100m, getting a long way back and charging home into third. The extra trip suits ideally, the barrier doesn't, but we'll back an in-form Ben Melham to get the job done. SILKY SETH (5) ran a solid race first up at Bendigo when settling on speed, fading into fifth late. Fitter for that and should run a good race. WHITEBAIT (11) is a gelding by Almanzor for the Waller yard who debuts. No doubt he'll get over a bit more ground in time but he's won a jumpout and looks to have good ability, respecting. DISCOVER LUPINO (2) resumes having shown glimpses in his maiden campaign. Like the booking of Ethan Brown first up, watch the market.
